{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kraren XI Superprocessor''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Processor/Legends|processor]]. They were installed in [[A9G-series Data Storage Unit]]s and allowed the droid to rapidly collate data.<ref name="TABSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Memory droid]]s contained multiple Kraren XI Superprocessors.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
